segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: For the record, House Bill No. 10858 has been formally referred to the Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: According to today's proceedings, it shall be conducted as a budget hearing on the bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: I would like to acknowledge the members and our resource persons.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: From the Commission on Human Rights,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: The Attorney Richard P. Palato, our Chairperson,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Commissioner Judge Maria Amifate Fider Reyes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: and also our Acting Executive Director, Lawrence Charles Isalazar,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: from Human Rights Violation Victims Memorial Commission.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Good afternoon po sa mga taga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: And of course, gusto ko rin pong i-acknowledge ang aking mga kasamahan sa mababang kongreso,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: ang tatlo sa masisipag kong kasamahan sa kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Siyempre po ang ating Deputy Minority Leader,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Congressman Percy Sandano from Akbayan Partylist,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Representative Dada Kiram Ismula from Akbayan Partylist,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: and also Assistant Minority Leader, Rene Co. of Kabatayan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: And siyempre po, presentin po ang ating pong Civil Society Organization,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Attorney Obe de la Cruz, National Coalition for the Family and Constitution,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Distinguished members of the Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: my esteemed colleagues in the House of Representatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Officials and Personnel of the Commission on Human Rights,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: magandang hapon po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: putting the CHR budget in perspective through one figure

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: that I hope will remain with this committee throughout this day,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Sa kabuang 7.2 trillion proposed national budget for 2027,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: the Commission on Human Rights is provided 1.273 billion pesos

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: or just 0.02% of the entire national budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: The CHR, however, proposed a total budget of 2.749 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Even if Congress were to provide this entire amount,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: it will still account for only around 0.04% of the national budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: to 0.04% if the entire CHR proposal were funded.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Ganoon po kaliit ang hinihing bahagi ng Commission on Human Rights

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Yet the responsibility entrusted to this constitutional institution

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: The CHR remains among the lowest funded institution of the national government,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: yet its mandate extends across the country

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: and touches the lives and rights of every Filipino.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: We expect the Commission to investigate,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: allege human rights violations and assist victims.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: We expect it to monitor jails and other places of deprivation of liberty,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: educate our people about their rights,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: and advise Congress and government on human rights laws and policies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Habang lumalaki po at nagiging komplikado ang haman sa karapatang pantao,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: kailangan din po natin tiyakin na meron po tayong sapat na kakayanan

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: at resources ang institusyong inaatasan ng ating konstitusyon para tumugon sa mga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Mga kasama, we cannot continue to demand more from our constitutional institution

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: without ensuring that it has the resources necessary

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: to effectively perform the responsibilities to entrust it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: And let us also be careful.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: The CHR is not advisory of government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Kakampi po natin ang CHR sa mabuting pamamahala.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Ang independent and adequately funded CHR helps government identify gaps,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: prevent abuses, protect vulnerable sectors, and strengthen accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: When the CHR tells us where government can do better,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: it helps us build stronger and more accountable,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: This is why the budget before us should not be viewed simply as funding for another government office.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: When we invest in CHR, we invest in justice, accountability, good governance, and human dignity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Kaya habang sinisimulan po natin ang debilirasyon ito,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: I ask my distinguished colleagues, tatatlo po tayong nandito ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Consider not only how much? Apat na po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: consider not only how much we can afford to provide the CHR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: but also what we expect the Commission to accomplish with the resources we give.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: After all, while CHR is provided only 0.02% of our national budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: the right it is constitutionally mandated to protect belongs to

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: one hundred percent of the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: With that, may I request the Chairperson of the Commission on Human Rights,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Distinguished Members of the Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: fellow public servants and everyone present today.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Magandang hapon po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: I am pleased to present the Commission on Human Rights proposed budget for fiscal year 2027 along with our accomplishment for 2025 and the first semester of 2026 and targets for 2027.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For most, I would like to thank our budget sponsor, Representative Maria Cristina Talavera Lopez, for her opening statement and continued advocacy and support for the CHR.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR's proposed budget aims to strengthen the Commission's delivery of services in line with its constitutional mandate for human rights protection and promotion,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: prevention of human rights violations in places of deprivation of liberty, and policy advisory services to strengthen the Philippine government's compliance with its human rights obligations.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: In terms of operations, the CHR has 726

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: out of 836 plantilla positions across the central office and 17 regional offices as of August 2026. With the permission of the Chair,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Let me begin by sharing the CHR's budget allocation and utilization rate.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Historically, the CHR's annual obligation rate has averaged 95% since 2019.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR strives to maintain its disbursement rate, which has stood at 100%.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Since 2024, and by the end of fiscal year 2026, it is estimated that the CHR will be able to maintain similar budget, obligation, and disbursement rates.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Now, allow me to present a detailed breakdown of the CHR's proposed budget for the fiscal year of 2027 in comparison with the 2027 National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: As shown in column 3, the CHR's original proposed budget for 2027 is 2.749 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: A total of 1.173 billion was proposed under Tier 1, while 1.576 billion was proposed under Tier 2.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR's total allocation under the 2027 NEP has been reduced by almost 53%,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: As shown in column No. 5, there is a deficit of 1.477 billion in the 2027 NEP proposal compared to the CHR's proposal under Tiers 1 and 2.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And this deficit mostly accounts for the Commission's capital outlay for 2027.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: As such, the breakdown of the CHR's 2027 NEP

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: 718,805,000 for personal services plus an additional 61.33 million for RLIP,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And for the maintenance and other operating expenses, 492,454,000.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Of course, the CHR is grateful to the Department of Budget and Management

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: for recognizing two of the Commission's important Tier 2 requirements.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: As seen in the lower right-hand corner of the presentation,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Andiyan po, binigyan po tayo ng DBM ng 16,019,000

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: for the visitorial mandate of the CHR through the expanded Places of Deprivation of Liberty,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: at 19,300,000 out of the 59 million for the augmentation of mandatory expenses

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: To provide further context, the next slide shows,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: compared with the 2026 GAA budget of 1.347 billion,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: May I invite you to please look at the figures listed in the last column.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: As seen in the row marked as grand total,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: there's an overall decrease of 74,882,000 out of the budget of the CHR.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The decrease is primarily due to the lack of capital outlay allocation

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For MOOE, there is a decrease amounting to a negative variance of 34,888,000.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And for personal services, there's an increase amounting to 103,549,000

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: due to the increase in the filled-up positions of the CHR

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and the implementation of the fourth tranche of the updated salary standardization law,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: automatic appropriations for retirement or RLIP.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Now allow me now to illustrate how resources translate into actual services.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR's constitutional mandate is discharged through the delivery of its programs in human rights protection,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: prevention of human rights violation, human rights promotion and policy advisory services.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, for protection services, the CHR focuses on the documentation and management of complaints,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: human rights violations, and general policies.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, for protection services, the CHR focuses on the documentation and management of complaints, human rights violations, and general policies.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: independent forensic services, legal assistance and counseling, financial assistance and witness protection, or security.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: In the first six months of 2026, the Commission received 2,942 cases of which 2,623 were already disposed or acted upon as of June 2026.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang breakdown po nito ay complaints received, meaning request for assistance, case investigation, and other protective services.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So through the Task Force Zero Backlog, the CHR has disposed of or acted upon 27,307 out of the 28,519

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Backlog cases, leaving a total of 1,212 pending cases from 1987 to 2025.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: This represents substantial progress in addressing long-standing cases of human rights violations.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Now for the prevention services of the Commission.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So the CHR is mandated to conduct regular visitation and conduct preventive monitoring of human rights violations.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: In places of deprivation of liberty such as jails, military and police custodial facilities, prison facilities, child-carest facilities and mental health facilities, among others.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For visits in places of detention, the Commission conducted 960 POD visits in 2024 and in 2025, 985.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The Commission focuses on detention facilities with highest incidences of torture

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Under this program, the CHR conducted 136 visits across 24 facilities in 2025

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and 16 visits across 12 facilities in the first semester of 2026

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR also regularly provides assistance to persons deprived of liberty

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: while 1,875 PDLs have been assisted for the first semester of 2026

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The Commission's current financial and human resources for its POD visitation program

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: allows it to visit, on average, only one-third of the recorded 2,920 detention facilities

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and, at most, one visit annually

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: This is precisely why the Commission welcomes the DBM's grant of P16,019,000

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: to expand the POD visitation program of the Commission

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: This will allow us to reach more facilities, identify risks earlier,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: recommend corrective measures, and help prevent human rights violations before they occur

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: is not limited to investigating human rights violations after they happen

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR has the constitutional mandate to establish a continuing program

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: of research, education, and information to enhance respect for the primacy of human rights

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Through its Human Rights Institute and the Lakbay Karapatan Tungo sa Kamalayan or LAKARAN program

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: the CHR has implemented 1,761 and served 122,950 clients in 2025

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For the first semester of 2026, the CHR has conducted 823 activities,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: under the Constitution, the CHR is also tasked with monitoring Philippine government's compliance

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: with international treaty obligations on human rights

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and providing the government with policy guidance on human rights

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR fulfills this mandate by issuing position papers, policy advisories, and situation reports

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For 2025, the CHR has released 127 issuances,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: while 94 have already been issued for the first semester of 2026

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So we are still on track as to our accomplishment

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: The CHR also regularly conducts community-based dialogues or CBDs with rights holders

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: to address localized human rights issues

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For 2025, a total of 34 CBDs have been conducted,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: We also regularly issue press statements to highlight pressing or urgent human rights concerns,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: laud government agencies' best practices and human rights,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and to celebrate key international and domestic human rights milestones

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For 2025, the CHR has issued 142 press statements

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: OK Yan sa Human Rights social media cards.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: To this end, the CHR respectfully forwards its proposed activities for support under Tier 2.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc

segments.text: and requests further support in the amount of 108.237 million

segments.text: sa other regular activities ng komisyon,

segments.text: napupunta po sa mga ganitong gastusin.

segments.text: given po na sa darating na taon

segments.text: Bagamat na zero po zero po

segments.text: kailangan po ng ating mga empleyado

segments.text: Madam Chair, if I may be allowed.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Tama po. Patuloy pa rin naman po ang aming stand and advocacy for the rejoining of our country sa International Criminal Court or the Rome Statute.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, katuwang po nito, ang ginagawa po ng komisyon ay continuous po ang ating pag-issue ng press statement and public pronouncements,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: development and dissemination of infographics or IEC materials, media engagement and public information activities,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and use of online platforms to consolidate ICC-related information.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Hindi po kasi parte ang komisyon.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Sa treaty negotiations or informal decisions on ICC, ang role po natin ay monitor, human rights monitor,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: meaning we can only send recommendations to the concerned agencies of the government upang makatulong sa advocacy na pag-rejoin sa ICC.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ngunit, katulad po ng nasabi ko,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: ang komisyon po ay patuloy at consistent po sa kanya stand na ang Pilipinas po ay mas nararapat na sumali ulit sa ICC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, meron po ba tayong formal recommendation, policy paper, advisory that we have addressed to various duty bearers reflecting this position and this recommendation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At kung meron po, sino-sino mga duty bearers po yung pinagpaabutan natin na

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Meron po tayo na isyong eight press statements related sa ICC, including the effects of Philippines withdrawal from the ICC,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: the government's decision not to rejoin the ICC,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: the ICC's pre-trial chamber's authorization to proceed with investigation,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: denial of the Philippine government's appeal to suspend the ICC probe and the issuance of warrant of arrest by the ICC in relation to the alleged crime against humanity involving the former president.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, then we also issued an EJK report which has been forwarded to all national government agencies including the DOJ, Philippine National Police, the PDEA, and others.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, marami pong salamat sa ating chairperson ng CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: This is a related point po to the earlier question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa human rights discourse sa Pilipinas, ang paglilitis kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: But narratives online and offline tell you otherwise.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Patuloy po ang pambababoy, pambabalahura, at pagdismiss sa mga biktima ng drug war.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ano po ba kung meron man ang efforts ng CHR para labanan ang ganito po mga narratives?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Regarding extrajudicial killing, EJK in relation to the drug war, patuloy po yung investigation ng komisyon.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Nabanggit ko po ng mga nakaraang mga hearings on budget deliberation ng Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Yung mga efforts na ginawa ng komisyon sa investigasyon at mga problema na na-encounter.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: At sa ngayon, patuloy pa rin po namin binabalikan yung mga kaso upang mabuo at ultimately matapos na po yung ating investigation tungkol dito.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Gayun din po, patuloy pa rin naman po yung ating assistance sa mga victims or families of victims.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Isa po sa mga accomplishment ng komisyon patungkol po dito,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, eto po, may kinreate po kasing task force ang komisyon na nag-review, nag-re-evaluate, nag-reopen ng mga cases.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: 140 cases na po yung for disposition nitong task force na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: We appreciate the efforts of the CHR in the reopening of these cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Napapansin lang po kasi ng marami, particular po yung nasa community,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: that CHR's voice is notably absent from the public discourse surrounding the ICC proceedings of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Siguro po, humble appeal to the CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Yung drug war victims po and their families deserve to know that the CHR has always stood and will stand with them in their pursuit of justice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kung naging very vocal po tayo on the issue of rejoining the ICC,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: sana ganun rin po tayo, ganun ka-vocal sa pag-suporta doon sa mga biktima po ng EJK

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: na ngayon po ay patuloy na binababoy sa daang mga masasamang puwersa habang ongoing po ang trial ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: I cannot overemphasize the role of CHR in reshaping public discourse on human rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Alam po natin, tayo ay nasa panahon ng recovery sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa mahabang panahon po, na-demonize ang human rights sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At may pagkakatoon po tayo ngayong panahon ito para itama yung pagkakamaling iyon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And we hope that we start that with rectifying these false narratives na ngayon po ay bastalong lumalaganap because of the ongoing ICC trial of former President Duterte.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me move to the last theme of my questions for this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The CHR previously announced its intention to strengthen work on the relationship between corruption and human rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Nag-adapt na po ba tayo ng policies, investigative framework, or strategic plans para i-frame ang corruption bilang isang human rights concern?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Yes, Madam Chair. Mayroon na pong ginawang activities and policies on ang Commission.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: In fact, we conducted two public symposiums on corruption.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: One on corruption and human rights upang alamin yung interrelation ng corruption and its effect on human rights.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ito po ay ginawa ng Commission at in attendance po dito ay some government agencies and civil society organizations as well as, of course, Your Honor, umattend po kayo doon under the focal chief of Commissioner Beda A. Epres.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And one activity is conducted by Commissioner Maria Amifaith S. Fider-Reyes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you very much again for the efforts of the Commission in this area.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At siguro po, mahalagang tanungin, para po may pagpatuloy yung trabaho natin dito sa pagbalangkas sa usapin ng korupsyon bilang isang human rights violation at human rights concern, ano po ba yung kailangan resources ng CHR para dito?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Siguro po, Madam Chair, ibabalik ko lamang po doon sa aming tier 2 request or proposals pagkat ito po ay makakatulong sa pagtupad ng Commission sa kanyang mandato.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: The government and the public must recognize that corruption is a human rights concern.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sa bawat piso na pupunta sa bulsa ng iilan, maraming karapatang pantao ang nilalapastangan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At ito pong ating investment sa Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: is not just about framing human rights as a civil political issue, but more than that, a socio-economic concern given the massive corruption happening in our country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: That's why Akbayan Partylist is fully supportive of restoring the tier 2 proposal of the Commission para po tunay na masabi natin sa Pilipinas, pinahahalagahan natin ang karapatang pantao.

segments.text: Of course, before we proceed, I would like to recognize na dagdagan na po tayo.

segments.text: My distinguished colleagues, a pleasant good afternoon to our family of the Commission on Human Rights, Richard, the chairman, Richard Palpal-latoc.

segments.text: I had at least three cases with you and I won all of them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, thank you, ma'am, for being here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Thank you for my victories, legal victories in your court.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we have Faydah Dumarpa, the daughter of my good friends, the Commissioner,

segments.text: the Congresswoman, Dumarpa, and our Executive Director, the Commissioner, Lawrence Salazar, and all the rest.

segments.text: I am here, Mr. Chairman, to really support the budget of the CHR, including its increase,

segments.text: because I have seen the reduction of the budget of the CHR from last year's level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: I am a co-author of the bill strengthening the CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And we hope that this will be passed because I have here my fellow co-authors who are very interested to strengthen the CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: So, we are here for that.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Now, going to the budget, so, as a premise, I support the strengthening of the Commission on Human Rights.

segments.text: But this budget will not strengthen them because we have reduced from 1.3...

segments.text: And how much is the tier 2?

segments.text: So, that we can have everything here.

segments.text: I am the vice chair of the Corporations Committee.

segments.text: And can we request you to submit first this tier 1, 74 million,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We don't think that everything will be given,

segments.text: but you give us the first three,

segments.text: probably amounting to about 300 to 400 million.

segments.text: You have to give us the fiscal space.

segments.text: So, you submit that to our committee chairman Lopez,

segments.text: you have a reduction of 34 million.

segments.text: It's very, very important that it be restored.

segments.text: plus 300 to 400 million of your priority in tier 2.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: We'll try to have increases here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Because anyway, it is Congress, the power of the purse,

segments.text: and with the vice chairman present here,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: Can you give us now the first three priorities of tier 2?

segments.text: The priorities would be, of course, strengthening the preventive mandate of the Commission.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Meron na pong initial increase na binigay ang DBM dito, but we still request na i-grant po yung remaining.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rufus B. Rodriguez
segments.text: And then, how much is that? How much?

segments.text: Ang naiwan po ay around 4 million na lamang.

segments.text: Ang request po namin ay 21, nabigyan po kami ng additional 16.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, mga 5, which we think, the DBM, then. So, mga 5 po yung remaining.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For number 2 would be the augmentation of mandatory expenses for the central office and regional offices,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: At toko yung, both of them would be, would enhance productivity of the Commission on Human Rights.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And then, next in the priority would be the capacity building program for Human Rights Action Center officers

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and capacity building of LGUs toward human rights cities.

segments.text: Ito po ay initiative ng Commission to localize human rights work.

segments.text: As well as rollout training for central and regional offices for newly developed CHR information systems.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Wala po kami pondo na para po dito.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: ano po, mostly databases and either ISSP activities amounting to 227 million.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, total, for all the, so 10 million lang po yung ano.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, total po ng priority would be 227 million.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And of course, Your Honor, we would like also to request additional budget for,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: kasi po meron po kaming role sa global and regional NHRI organizations.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: I personally sit as the chairperson of the Working Group on Business and Human Rights of the Global Alliance of National Human Rights Institution.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc

segments.text: madami pong government agencies ang hindi pa rin compliant doon sa requirement ng RA 9710.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, meron po ba tayong ginagawa kapag

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: ang nakikita po kasi natin, consistent yung failure to comply with the requirements of the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Parang taon-taon po talaga hindi nagagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So ano po ang pwedeng magawa ng CHR diyan?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang ginawa po ng Commission at ng PCW dito sa aspetong ito ay

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: nag-issue po kami jointly with the PCW

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: ng notice po sa mga agencies upang sila ay magpaliwanag kung bakit hindi nila

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: nasusunod, natutupad yung requirements ng batas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Meron na po bang mga paliwanag? Do we have anything na?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: This year po namin nagawa yun. So siguro ongoing po, wala po kasi akong data sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ongoing po yung pasok siguro ng mga compliance ng mga government agencies dito.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: We'll just provide update po kung ano man po yung merong available sa amin sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yes po. Siguro ang pakiusap ko na lamang po sa CHR na maging medyo ano po tayo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: stricto siguro this time kasi antagal-tagal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: na po nung batas. Hindi po nako-comply talaga yung nakasaad doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maybe it's about time that maging seryoso po tayo sa paghahabol sa mga ahensya

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: to comply with the provisions of the law.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So my last question would be, Madam Speaker, yung budget cut from your original proposal

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: to the NEP level, will that significantly affect the function and role of the CHR

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Bago ko lang po sagutin, balikan ko lamang po yung kanina una on the compliance of government agencies.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So ang isa pong strategy na ginawa ng commission ng CHR at ng PCW is we come up with a memorandum of agreement

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: para kami po ay we can jointly monitor the compliance of these government agencies under the Magna Carta of Women.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: sumunod na katanungan, as I said, katulad po ng mga tanong kanina na nauna,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: of course, maapektuhan po yung aming serbisyo dahil sa budget and resources.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Dahil patuloy, ito po ay regular nang naging problema ng komisyon

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and we learned to adapt, actually, kung paano namin gagamitin yung meager resources of the commission.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: But of course, it would help.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: if the Congress would grant us additional budget for this.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Especially kung dedicated po, ang budget po ay dedicated for the compliance as the gender ombud,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: In fact, sa mga previous budget deliberation in previous years po,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: isa po ito sa mga hinahilayit ng komisyon,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: yung mga special laws providing additional mandates.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: to the commission na wala pong additional budget na binibigay.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Patuloy pa rin namin hihingin, kung sakali pong, if you would be generous enough to grant the CHR budget

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: for these special laws or special mandates provided to us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Madam Chair, I therefore join our colleagues in their call

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: to restore the original proposed budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Thank you, Representative Iris Montes, for your support sa increase pa rin ng CHR budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Ma. Cristina Talavera Lopez
segments.text: Next on line po, from minority, Representative Sara Ilago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nais kong malaman kung ano ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Human Rights Protection Program, Human Rights Promotion Program, at Human Rights Policy Advisory Program.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So ang budget po na nasama sa NEP for personal service, P718,805,000 yung pong binigay sa NEP.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Kung ang tinatanong po natin ay yung distribution nito sa mga core services.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So for majority po kasi ng budget personal service.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So for the protection, ang allocated budget po ay,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Then for Human Rights Promotion Program, P90,480,000.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For Human Rights Policy Program, P79,342,000.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: And then for Jail Visitation, P28,086,000.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Bahagi po siya ng total ng protection program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At marami po dito ay napakalayo doon sa original proposal ng CHR

segments.text: para magampana ng buong-buo ang kanilang napakahalagang trabaho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya po, nais ko pong malaman rin kung yung mga pondo, halimbawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa po yung Child Rights Center, Center for Gender Equality and Women's Human Rights,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At lahat po ng ating mga centers sa ilalim po ng CHR.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Paano humaapektuhan ang trabaho ng mga centers na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At dahil hindi po naibibigay ng buong po yung hinihiling natin na kinakailangan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa pagampan ng atungkulin para sa susunod na taon?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Unang-una po, iyong pong budget, kung tinatanong niyo po sa ating mga centers,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: nakapaloob po siya doon sa Human Rights Policy Program.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Sa Human Rights Policy Program po ay dalawa po yung core functions na ginagawa dito.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ito po yung Policy Linkages Offices, kung ito yung gumagawa ng monitoring activities

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, naghahati po sila doon sa budget na...

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Sa pondong ito, kaya naman pong tugunan yung mga existing activities and programs.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Hindi po natin kakayani mag-introduce ng bagong mga...

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: or expansion ng mga existing activities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Walang expansion, Madam Chair, pero meron po kayong naging proposal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Inais ko rin pong mabanggit na rin, for the record,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang Center for Disability and Health-Related Rights

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at ang Center for Social Justice and Humanitarian Protection.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Abukad pa po sa napakahalaga na Child Rights Center

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at Center for Gender Equality and Women's Human Rights.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mahalaga ito, Madam Chair, dahil sa mga gawain din natin dito sa Kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung mga nilalabas ko ng mga situation reports,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: policy analysis na nilalabas ng mga centers na ito

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: bilang reference sa mga ginagawa natin ng mga panukala dito sa Kongreso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya ho, lahat ng maibibigay natin na pagtulak at pagsisika

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para matugunan yung mga hindi na bigyan ng pondo sa NEP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At dapat ho gawin ng committee and appropriations na bigyan ng prioridad ang mga ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Madam Chair, tungkol ho sa mga naisagawang community,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: mga community dialogues, mga community-based dialogues.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang mga regional at local, ang mga regional offices po ba natin sa buong bansa

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ay nakapagsagawa ng ganitong tipo ng mga dialogues?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Yes po, Madam Chair, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Kasama po sa mga regular activities ng ating mga regional offices,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ilan po yung mga participants at mga naaabot ng mga dialogues na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: At kung meron din kayong information,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa mga NGOs, civil society organizations na naaabot natin pagdating sa mga diyalogo na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mahalaga ito, Madam Chair, kasi ito yung magtitiyak na nakalapat sa katotohanan

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: kung ano man yung mga programa, proyekto, aktividad na sinasagawa ng CHR,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lalong-lalo na sa pagtindig para sa karapatang pantao.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: For 2025 po, nakapagsagawa po ang komisyon ng 34 community-based dialogues.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Sa ngayon po, as of June 2026, mayroon na po tayo nagawang 16 community-based dialogues.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Hindi po ako makapagbigay ng actual na bilang ng kung ilan yung participants,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: but based on our promotion activities, kasi kasama po sa mga CBDs namin ay promotion activities,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: meron po kaming talang 122,950 individuals who participated in promotion activities.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: In 2025, sa ngayon po, as of June 2026, meron na pong 51,716 individuals.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Chair, at marami tayong naaabot.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero kung itutumbas din natin ito, kung makikita po natin yung ulat ng CHR para sa Human Rights Education Program,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: malaki talaga na limitation yung kulang na pondo pagdating sa pag-abot sa mas malawak pa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kasi bagamat marami, nasa libo na.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero milyong-milyong mga Pilipino pa yung hindi naaabot ng ganitong tipo ng mga programa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kaya nais ko rin malaman kung may pag-uusap ba sa ngayon sa DepEd, sa CHED,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: at sa mga institutions natin na ma-integrate din yung Human Rights Education.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Alam ko, Madam Chair, may mga panukala dito sa Kongreso para ma-institutionalize ang Human Rights Education,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: pero sa bahagi ngayon ng CHR, meron na ba tayong mga existing na mga partnerships sa iba't ibang institutions

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para mapalakas ang ating Human Rights Education Program?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Unang-una po, Madam Chair, Your Honor, unang-una po, patuloy po yung ugnayan natin with the Commission on Higher Education

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: and DepEd on Human Rights Education, including the review of the curriculum ng mga kurso.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, on the part of the...

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: On the part of the Commission on Human Rights, yun po palang ugnayan na yun with the DepEd and CHED

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: ay kasama po ang may initiative po ang Commission on Human Rights as well as HRBBMC

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: On, of course, for MEMCOM, yung pong martial law, ang CHR naman as the general concept of human rights.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: On the part of the Commission on Human Rights, we have existing partnership with higher educational institutions all over the Philippines.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang tawag po namin sa kanila ay Center for Human Rights Education.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Partnership po ito with this higher educational institution for human rights promotion and research.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ongoing discussion with the Philippine Association of Law Schools on the inclusion of...

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Collaboration with the PALS on human rights activities and promotions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, hingin na lang po natin yung ulat na tungkol sa extension of services or outreach efforts po natin

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Public at private actors sa human rights education.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman ho, sa naulat nyo kanina, nasa 800 plus yung cases na lumapit ho sa inyo

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na may kinalaman sa gender-based violence.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Lahat ho ba ito ay may kinalaman sa state-perpetrated, state-sponsored or condoned

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: by any means na type ng violence against women and all genders?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, kailangan natin i-disaggregate yung data.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Kasi, halo po ito, merong state actor or state sanctioned or state agent.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Meron, karamihan dito actually ay private individuals ang respondents.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Pero dahil kasama po sa mandato natin na tignan, yung due diligence, compliance ng ating pamahalaan

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: on the protection and promotion of human rights.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: At kasama po sa inaimbestigaan ng komisyon ito.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, ang objective would be to determine kung sapat po ba yung mga mekanismo at mga solusyon at tugon

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: na ginagawaan ng ating pamahalaan sa mga kaso ng paglabag ng karapatan ng kababaihan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Madam Chair, kukunin ho natin yung disaggregated data at tungkol dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Pero para sa mga kaso halimbawa na state-perpetrated or state-sponsored,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: lahat ho ba ng mga kaso na lumalapit sa inyo ay nadidispose po natin agad, na-address po natin agad?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: O may mga challenges pa ho?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Halimbawa, pag natitiyak natin na mapapatawag ang dapat mapatawag,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: nagagawa ho ba ito? At meron bang nananagot?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Yes po, nagagawa naman po ito at natatapos din agad.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Although, katulad nung nabanggit ko kanina, Madam Chair, Your Honor,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: tinutukan po ng komisyon yung backlog.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: From 1987 to 2025, more than 20,000 or almost 30,000 cases po ito.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, pagkatapos po yan, mas makakatutok na kami sa mga current cases na nasa around 2,942 cases na lamang po tayo.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: So, mas mapapabilis na po yung investigation and conclusion of the investigation of these cases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa paghabon ng backlog at malaki po ang magagawa kung ma-restore yung pondo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Hindi nga lang ma-restore dun sa previously approved, pero matiyak po natin na madadagdagan yung pondo

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: para sa human rights protection promotion, education, at mga policy-related programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Bilang panghuli po sa kalagayan ng mga human rights defenders, may mga kababaihan po na dumulog at naghahin ng complaint,

segments.text: ng reklamo sa harap ng CHR.

segments.text: Tungkol po sa presence ng mga civil-military operations battalion dito mismo sa National Capital Region

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: na nagkakaroon po ng mga kaso ng profiling, surveillance, at threats at intimidation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Meron na po bang ulat ang CHR tungkol dito?

segments.text: At ano po po yung mga kailangan natin para mapalakas po yung paggampa ng mandato?

segments.text: Ang CHR pagdating sa ganitong tipo ng mga kaso?

segments.text: Wala po akong actual data sa ngayon nung tinutukoy po ninyong kaso or insidente.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: We'll just provide it to you, Your Honor, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Kung yung pong tinatanong po ninyo, ano pa ang dapat gawin upang mapalakas?

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang isa po sa mga pinaplano ng komisyon ay isang national preventive mechanism,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Pillars ito ng protection mechanism for human rights defenders.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Pillar one would be the early warning system o tawag po namin ay bantay

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: upang agad-agad naming matukoy ang mga human rights violations at agad din kami makatugon.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang pangalawa pong pillar nito ay the protection mechanism itself.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Yun po yung mga existing activities and programs of the commission.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Which include investigation, witness protection and support to victims.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: At ang pangatlo po yung national monitoring mechanism

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: kung saan ang tawag po namin sa pillar na yun ay tugon or gabay.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang objective po nun ay policy recommendation.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: Ang objective po ay pulungin ang mga stakeholders including government agencies and civil society

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: upang pag-usapan kung ano ang problema sa karapatang pantao at hanapan ng solusyon

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: kung ano man yung pupwedeng tugunan agad-agad or ano yung pupwedeng unti-unting ma-address.

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: protection mechanism na ito, and hopefully

segments.text: Madam Chair, pang huli na po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: sa kalagayan po na ito, halimbawa,

segments.text: at sa iba pong mga civilian facilities,

segments.speaker: CHR Chairperson Richard P. Palpal-latoc
segments.text: meron pong mga specific incident dito.

segments.text: kung saan meron po kaming kasunduan
